snippet.title: Fruits Vs Veggies Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Check it out on Steam!

Fruits Vs Veggies is a team-based party platformer where you and your friends compete in a series of fast-paced minigames. Put your skills to the test by using a range of items to outperform your foes, or explore the vast campaign to uncover the origins of the carnage.
